meta.title: Bold, Italic and More
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Bold, Italic and More".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Bold, Italic and More', 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more', '

In this tour you get to know the editor: its toolbar, bold, italic, underline and strikethrough, and how to paste text without its formatting.

You also start the article Our Services, which the next tutorials of this chapter build on.

This tour follows the tutorial 3.1 Bold, Italic and More of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 3.1 Bold, Italic and More', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Create a new article', '

Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Give the article a title', '

Type the title:

Our Services

Then click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-article #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'The editor and its toolbar', '

The editor has a toolbar and an area for the text. Not all tools fit in the first row.

  1. Click the ⋯ icon at the end of the toolbar. A second row opens with many more tools: headings, lists, links, tables and more.
  2. Click ⋯ again to close it.
  3. Hover over a few icons: a tooltip shows the name of each tool.

Then click Next.

', 5, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough', '
  1. Click in the text area and type a line of practice text, for example: Practice makes perfect.
  2. Select the text and click the B icon (Bold). The icon is highlighted and the text turns bold.
  3. Click B again: the bold is gone. Each formatting icon switches its format on and off.
  4. Try Italic, Underline and Strikethrough on the same text.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'The popup toolbar', '

Select the practice text again.

A small popup toolbar appears, with bold, italic, underline and a few other tools you use often. Its icons change the selected text just like the icons of the main toolbar.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Paste with formatting', '
  1. Select this example text here and copy it (Ctrl+C, on a Mac ⌘+C):
    This is bold text and this is italic text.
  2. Click below the practice text in the editor and paste it (Ctrl+V or ⌘+V).

The pasted text keeps its bold and italic: a normal paste carries the formatting of the source along, which is not always what you want.

Then click Next.

', 8, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Paste as text', '
  1. Click the Paste as text icon, a clipboard with a T (in the second row, under ⋯). It is highlighted: Paste as text is on.
  2. Click below the pasted text and paste the example again. This time it has no formatting at all.
  3. Click Paste as text again to switch it off.

Text from Word, web pages or PDFs often brings hidden fonts, colours and spacing along. Paste as text leaves only the plain text.

Then click Next.

', 9, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Write the opening paragraph', '
  1. Delete the practice text and both pasted examples.
  2. Type this as the article text:
    We help growing companies get more value from their technology investments. Our team is known for careful, hands-on work, and we stay involved long after the project ends.
  3. Select careful, hands-on work and make it Bold.
  4. Select long after the project ends and make it Italic.

Then click Next.

', 10, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-bold-italic-and-more'), 'Well done!', '

Our Services is saved with its opening paragraph.

In the next tutorial, Headings, you open it again and give it an outline.

', 12, 'top', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
